title: MURAD: A Large-Scale Multi-Domain Unified Reverse Arabic Dictionary Dataset
reasoning: The paper presents a dataset where 'Islamic' is one of the four primary thematic categories, accounting for 18.57% of the total entries (over 18,000 pairs). It specifically includes terminology from specialized religious domains like Fiqh (jurisprudence) and Aqidah (creed), and utilizes authoritative sources such as the 'Encyclopedia of Faith Terminology' and 'Dictionary of Islamic Jurisprudence Terms'.
